'''Tom Conerly''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Hatfield tournament]] on 15 July 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA]], according to Chris Moore's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2648">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-16-hatfield-uk-07-15-2001d2648/ hatfield-uk-07-15-2001], DeckTech (Chris "Lt. Cabbage" Moore, 16 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-16-hatfield-uk-07-15-2001d2648/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
